description: This file defines classes for traversing and transforming Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) in a shader compiler context, including base classes for AST traversers and specialized traversers that track l-values.

classes.name: TIntermTraverser
classes.description: Base class for AST traversers that walk and optionally transform nodes in the AST.

classes.name: TLValueTrackingTraverser
classes.description: Derived class that tracks whether nodes are l-values during traversal, used for write operations.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Visit a symbol node in the AST.

methods.name: visitGlobalQualifierDeclaration
methods.description: Visit a global qualifier declaration node.

methods.name: visitBranch
methods.description: Visit a branch (break, continue, return) node.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Template method to traverse a node of any type.

methods.name: updateTree
methods.description: Update the AST with queued replacements after traversal.

methods.name: queueReplacement
methods.description: Queue a node replacement during traversal.

methods.name: queueReplacementWithParent
methods.description: Queue a node replacement with explicit parent reference.

methods.name: setOperatorRequiresLValue
methods.description: Set whether the current operator requires an l-value.

methods.name: setInFunctionCallOutParameter
methods.description: Set whether inside a function call out parameter.
